# dsh-cost-balance-chip
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web plugin that puts **this conversation's estimated spend** and the **acco
unt balance** beside the message composer.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
A community plugin, not an official DeepSeek package. The spend figure is an estimate; the platform
bill remains authoritative.
Repository: <https://github.com/jieyueriluo/DSH_balance-chip> · npm: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/
dsh-cost-balance-chip>
## What it does
- Adds a compact two-line chip to `conversation.input.right`, the right-hand control cluster inside

the composer card, immediately before the model selector.
- **本次 / This chat** — estimated spend for
the current Session, computed from the durable `tokenUsage` projection and the selected model's ref

erence unit prices.
- **余额 / Balance** — the account's available balance (topped-up wallet + granted
wallet). Refreshes on mount, every 30 seconds, when the page becomes visible, and shortly after eac

h usage settlement.
- Click the chip for a detail panel:
- model and cache-hit rate;
- input, output

ranted wallets, last refresh time, and a manual refresh control.
- The leading dot pulses while the

Session is running.
- Follows the DSH UI language (`zh` / `en`) and the active light/dark theme.
- I
f the balance cannot be read, the chip shows `—` instead of inventing a zero; the panel states the r
eason and offers a retry.

b page after installing.
## Pricing
The client has no billing API, so spend is estimated from provider-reported token buckets. Reference
unit prices are CNY per one million tokens:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- `input` — uncached input tokens.
- `cacheRead` — cache-hit tokens.
- `cacheWrite` — cache-write to

kens.
- `output` — output tokens.
Edit `client.js` and reload the page if your account's price list differs. The panel shows the rates
nt.js` and reload the page if your account's price list differs. The panel shows the rates in force.
**Limitation:** when a Session switches models, all of its tokens are currently priced at the latest
selected model. A per-request split would require reading the full Session log and segmenting by re
el. A per-request split would require reading the full Session log and segmenting by request header.
## How it works
- Spend: `useProjection('tokenUsage')` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter`, which folds the complete

durable Session log into four disjoint buckets.
- Model: `useProjection('modelSelection')`, using `

next.model` and falling back to `lastUsed.model`.
- Balance: `ctx.remote.account.getBalance(clientMe

tadata)`, with the plugin explicitly injecting the `remote.account` namespace.
- Running state: the

Session standard hook; it only drives the pulse animation.
- No Host half is needed: `index.js` expo
rts an empty `apply()`.
The plugin never reads or uploads credentials. The balance request goes through DSH's own `remote.ac
ver reads or uploads credentials. The balance request goes through DSH's own `remote.account` proxy.
## Compatibility

- DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3` (declared in `engines.dsh`).
- Web Client only; no model-facing tools or prompt

s are registered.
- No React or DSH Client package imports beyond the platform's `react` / `react-do

.
- No React or DSH Client package imports beyond the platform's `react` / `react-dom` seed modules.

## English summary
A composer chip for DSH showing the current conversation's estimated cost and the account's availabl
e balance, with a click-through token/cost breakdown. Costs are estimated from the `tokenUsage` proj
ection and reference prices; the balance is read through DSH's account Remote. MIT licensed, no cred
ence prices; the balance is read through DSH's account Remote. MIT licensed, no credentials touched.
